pictures.name: ZSF1-Godavari
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold light, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, letters or writing of any script (no Gurmukhi), no logos or modern objects. Gentle and peaceful, no violence, no injury. The wide Godavari river at Nanded at dusk in 1708: a camp of tents on the riverbank, Sikh men and women with covered heads gathering quietly, worried faces lit by low sun. In the distance, a tall figure in a blue robe and blue turban stands by the water, seen only from behind. Gold and deep blue. The Guru is seen only from directly behind or very far away: no face, no profile, no cheek, no partial face is ever visible.
